results.title: Israeli singer Ben Raivitz shows his gratitude to Captain Smit Machchhar; sings Hanuman Chalisa for the Flydubai ‘hero’
results.description: During a terrifying flight ordeal, Smit Machchhar turned to the soothing words of the Hanuman Chalisa for strength. In a show of solidarity, Israeli singer Ben Raivitz chose to dedicate a hymn performance to Machchhar, which quickly gained traction on social media. The gesture sparked an outpouring of support, highlighting how shared faith can create bonds that transcend borders and resonate powerfully through music.

results.title: Shimla: Man Arrested for Snatching Jewellery After Throwing Chilli Powder at Women
results.description: A 26-year-old man from Doda, Jammu and Kashmir, was arrested in Kumarsain for allegedly snatching gold jewellery from women after throwing chilli powder into their eyes, Shimla Police said. According to ASP Mehar Panwar, the accused surveyed routes in advance and targeted women on isolated stretches across three separate incidents between August and September.

results.title: From Shakti to Aravalli: India's helicopter engine journey takes shape
results.description: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh inaugurated a second production line for Shakti helicopter engines at HAL's Koraput division. This facility is expected to be fully operational by 2028-29 and will produce up to 100 engines annually. HAL is also increasing the production capacity of AL-31FP engines for the Su-30MKI to support aircraft operations. The Shakti engine development exemplifies India's progress in aerospace technology and indigenous manufacturing capabilities.
